messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — Orchid dedicated GPU check-in. Over the last 48h we've hit sustained saturation on their reserved pool. Wanted to surface metrics before Monday's renewal prep.

orchid-pm: Thanks, that's worrying. What's the immediate severity? Renewal conversation is in ~3 weeks.

Maria (CS): Quick snapshot:
- GPU hours (7d): 3,420h (+18% w/w)
- Peak saturation: 96% (01:23 UTC yesterday)
- Average queue depth: 9.6 (p95 queue depth 14)
- Avg token latency increase: +70ms (baseline 230ms -> 300ms)
- Error rate (inference 4xx/5xx): 0.6% baseline -> 1.1% spike during peaks
- Estimated overage this billing cycle: ~$9.2k

Raw peek:
```
qdepth: [6,8,9,12,14]
saturation: [78,85,88,92,96]
reserved_hours_used: 96% of committed
```

orchid-infra: That aligns with what we saw — a large finetune batch ran last night and wasn't throttled. Might be the cause.

Priya (Capacity Eng): Assigning to me. I'll check autoscale policy, burst capacity logs, and whether preemptible capacity was denied. Can @orchid-infra paste the finetune job schedule?

orchid-infra: job: nightly-finetune @ 00:30 UTC, duration ~3h, GPU count 40. Deployed last week per research request.

Jon (Eng): Also noting routing behavior — fallback to smaller model_variant didn't trigger during the pressure window. Looks like a routing tag mismatch; I'll validate routing rules and logs.

Maria (CS): Action items:
- Priya: verify autoscale and burst decisions; flag if burst was blocked (COB today)
- Jon: confirm fallback routing and whether it failed (COB today)
- orchid-infra: consider shifting finetune off-peak or reducing parallel workers
- Maria: prepare a renewal risk note + cost/options (1-2 levers)

Please react with :eyes: when you have an update.

Priya (Capacity Eng): :eyes: on it, will update in-thread with findings.

Jon (Eng): :thumbsup: running policy check now.

orchid-pm: Appreciate the escalation. If a commit bump is needed we'll discuss pricing — please add expected impact numbers after triage.

deploy-bot: Scheduled alert created — incident 2026-USB-6722 linked to this thread.

Maria (CS): Thanks all. I'll follow up in Friday's sync, but escalate earlier if we see >98% sustained for 6+ hours or another latency spike.
